blurb: Guests rent luxury yachts and boats ranging from 30 to 100 feet for cruising Miami waters including Biscayne Bay, Star Island, Millionaire's Row, and Miami Beach. Boats include amenities such as premium audio systems, floating water mats, restrooms, sunbathing decks, and coolers with water and ice. Guests can bring their own food and drinks on board.
extraNote: Free cancellations until 5 days before booking start date · 50% refund for cancellations 2-5 days before booking start date · No refund for cancellations within 2 days of booking start date · If weather unsafe to sail, reschedule or full refund offered
